ai_summary: NOVA GLOBAL OPPORTUNITIES FUND PCC - TOUCHSTONE has significantly reduced its stake in AAA TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED by selling 400,000 shares through an open market transaction. This sale, executed on September 25, 2026, decreased the non-promoter fund's holding from 6.57% to 3.45% of the target company's total share capital, bringing its ownership below a common substantial shareholding threshold. A notable red flag is that the reported transaction and disclosure dates are in the future (2026), which is highly unusual for such a filing.
